request.contents:
Does the Residential Tenancies Act, 2006 (Ontario) make this clause of a residential tenancy agreement void?

Read the clause as a term of an ordinary private residential tenancy in Ontario that the Residential Tenancies Act, 2006 covers: the rental unit has no exemption under section 6.1, and it is not student housing, a care home, a co-operative or a mobile home park.

You are not given the text of the Act. Answer from what you know of it.

<clause>
As a condition of this Agreement, the Tenant agrees that the tenancy will end, and the Tenant will move out, on the last day of the term.
</clause>

Answer with:
- verdict: "void" if the Act makes the clause void, "allowed" if the Act permits it, or "unsure" if you can't decide.
- section: the number of the one section that decides it, such as "14", without a subsection. Empty if unsure.
- quote: the words of that section that decide it, exactly as they appear in the Act: one continuous passage from a single subsection, at least five words, with nothing left out, added or changed. Not a heading. Empty if unsure.
- reason: one or two sentences.

text: {"verdict": "void", "section": "37", "quote": "A notice of termination need not be given if a landlord and a tenant have agreed to terminate a tenancy, but an agreement to terminate a tenancy is void if it is entered into at the time the tenancy agreement is entered into.", "reason": "Under subsection 37(5)(a) of the Residential Tenancies Act, 2006, an agreement to terminate a tenancy is void if it is entered into at the time the tenancy agreement is made, except in specific exempt situations such as certain post-secondary student housing. Furthermore, section 38 automatically renews a fixed-term tenancy into a monthly tenancy upon its expiration unless validly terminated under the Act."}

parsed.quote: A notice of termination need not be given if a landlord and a tenant have agreed to terminate a tenancy, but an agreement to terminate a tenancy is void if it is entered into at the time the tenancy agreement is entered into.
parsed.reason: Under subsection 37(5)(a) of the Residential Tenancies Act, 2006, an agreement to terminate a tenancy is void if it is entered into at the time the tenancy agreement is made, except in specific exempt situations such as certain post-secondary student housing. Furthermore, section 38 automatically renews a fixed-term tenancy into a monthly tenancy upon its expiration unless validly terminated under the Act.
